name: Iran
famous_for: Ancient ruins of Persepolis, Persian turquoise-tiled mosques in Isfahan, intricate hand-knotted rugs, and Hafez poetry.
tourists: Approx. 4.1M visitors; famous for Naqsh-e Jahan Square, Pink Mosque (Nasir al-Mulk), and Yazd desert wind-catchers.
must_know: 'Taarof' is an intricate cultural ritual of politeness where people defer to each other out of deep respect before accepting an offer.
fun_fact: Persepolis was the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Persian Empire under Darius the Great around 518 BC.
